Resolves #20460

A scroll event that the main thread dispatched before it applied an anchor correction reached the worker after the correction. The worker then re-synced the bodies to the old offset, and the next correction built on that offset. The main thread painted the corrected scroll position over rows rendered for a different place, which is the one-frame blink.

The fix has two parts:
- `GridRowScrollPinning` stamps the view node with the last applied correction epoch (`data-scroll-epoch`). Every scroll event already carries its target's dataset.
- `View#reconcileScrollTop` adds the corrections a report predates. The `ScrollManager`'s offset follows each correction, so its buffered scroll end cannot re-sync to the old place either.

Evidence: L3 (real-browser e2e under CI dispatch) → L3 required (AC-2, AC-3). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Receipt: CI dispatch runs 42246353012 and 42246357781 on the unfixed head with the batch-meta probe. Every failing frame shows the same sequence. Correction 4 moved the worker from 6064 to 7120. A scroll report of 6064 then re-synced it. Correction 5 shipped `scrollTop: 6704` (6064 + 640) while the DOM landed on 7760. The rendered ids in that frame were 95–144, without the anchor row 146. |
| AC-2 | Fixed on the side the receipt names: the worker re-synced to a pre-correction offset. The assertion is unchanged, so every frame must still show the anchor row at its edge. Two new unit tests are red on the unfixed source and green here: `a scroll the main thread reported before it applied a correction lands where the correction moved the rows` and `the view node carries the epoch of the last correction, which a scroll event reports to the worker`. |
| AC-3 | It does not reproduce locally (25/25 plain, 15/15 at CPU ×6), so this relies on the receipt and on CI dispatch with the same instrument (`repeatEach=12`). Unfixed head: 5 failures in 252 runs. Fixed head: 0 in 336. Locally, the fixed head passes `--repeat-each=30`: 210 of 210. |
| AC-4 | The same dispatch runs every arm of the spec. All 84 passed in each of the 4 runs at the fixed head. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket suspected the window derivation (`Body#createViewData` against `View#changeRowHeights`). The probe cleared it. The window was right for the offset the worker held, but that offset was stale.
- The private `View#correctScrollTop` now holds the bookkeeping that both correction sites repeated.

## Test Evidence

- CI dispatch on the unfixed head `1ee11ca975` (with probes): run 42246348227 passed 84. Run 42246353012 failed 4 and passed 80. Run 42246357781 failed 1 and passed 83.
- CI dispatch on the fixed head `eed534a824` (same probes): runs 42248016632, 42248021082, 42248025985 and 42248030110 passed 84 each.
- Both heads live on `ada/20460-anchor-null-frame`. This branch carries the fix without the temporary probes.
- Local, fixed head: `--repeat-each=30` passed 210 of 210 (7 tests × 30).
